requirement:
Create `app/validators.py` with `check_password(password: str, username: str = "") -> list[str]` returning the list of violated rule codes in this fixed order (empty list = acceptable): `too_short` (fewer than 12 characters), `no_upper`, `no_lower`, `no_digit`, `no_symbol` (no character that is not a letter or digit), `has_space` (contains whitespace), `contains_username` (username is non-empty and appears in the password, case-insensitively), `common` (the password, lower-cased, is one of: password, 123456789012, qwertyuiop12, letmein12345).
The project must also contain `app/main.py` defining a FastAPI `app` (entry point `app.main:app`) (no endpoints required) and `app/__init__.py`. Include unit tests (pytest).
acceptance_criteria: Every violated rule is reported once, in the specified order
Acceptable passwords return an empty list

rubric.partial: hidden_pass_rate is the fraction of hidden tests passed; reported separately
rubric.notes: hidden tests are executed in a separate, independent step; the agents' own tests do not count
